description:
You are auditing a bibliography for a machine learning survey. Several papers were imported incorrectly as 'Journal Article' but are actually 'Conference Paper' (published in proceedings like NeurIPS, CVPR).

Your task:
1. Open Zotero.
2. Locate the following three papers and change their Item Type from 'Journal Article' to 'Conference Paper':
   - 'Attention Is All You Need' (Vaswani et al.)
   - 'ImageNet Classification with Deep Convolutional Neural Networks' (Krizhevsky et al.)
   - 'Deep Residual Learning for Image Recognition' (He et al.)

3. Locate the paper 'Mastering the Game of Go with Deep Neural Networks and Tree Search' (Silver et al.) and ensure it remains a 'Journal Article' (it was published in Nature, so Journal Article is correct).

Do NOT change any other metadata fields, just the Item Type.

targets.title: ImageNet Classification with Deep Convolutional Neural Networks
Deep Residual Learning for Image Recognition
Mastering the Game of Go with Deep Neural Networks and Tree Search
